content.TextMessage: The village was overrun by gnolls!

events.name: At the beginning of the scene...

events.comment: Devem estar em ordem decrescente de valor para poder selecionar sempre o mais improvável no caso de low roll.

parameters: "YOU WIN! YOU SEE GNOLLS VERY GOOD! And that's what they needed in the end, they were so lonely! But not anymore. The real gnolls were the friends we made on the way after all."
